set.body:
Outcome
Create the first complete executable specimen with realistic content and window behavior.

Owned scope
meridian-sampler workspace fixture; minimal workbench compositions; deterministic synthetic data

Prerequisites
B1

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Use a real JavaFX table, synthetic scientific viewport, inspector and console in ScalaDock; sidebar/location navigation and movable-pane tabs have distinct roles.
- [ ] Filtering, row selection, no-results, hidden-selection policy, a real validation dialog and context menu behave coherently. Adopt clear-selection on filtered-out rows unless a visible retained-selection explanation is implemented and tested.
- [ ] Inspector can pop out, dock back, minimize, reopen and recover at 800×600 logical viewport; necessary controls remain reachable through scrolling or overflow.
- [ ] Save/load, perspective switch, close veto and drag cancellation preserve pane identities and values; a single-pane float has one title/header treatment.
- [ ] Record fixed synthetic fixture IDs, dimensions and initial selection for repeatable captures; include active, inactive and keyboard-focused states.

Required evidence
Four variant native captures plus deterministic interaction script/probes, instance counters, saved-layout and selected-object assertions.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code B2. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [B2] Build the native dataset and scientific docked workspace
